item.title: Elkhart Council Approves Creation Of Outdoor Drinking Area
item.description: The Elkhart City Council voted 8-1 Monday, Feb. 2 to approve creation of a downtown Designated Outdoor Refreshment Area, a move city leaders say is intended to increase foot traffic and stimulate local economic activity.

item.title: Seventh Annual Garden Expo, March 7
item.description: The seventh annual Michiana Master Gardeners Association’s Garden Expo will be held from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Saturday, March 7, at the Faith United Church located at 22045 CR 18, on the corner of CR 17, in Elkhart.

item.title: Student Entrepreneurs Take the Stage at FEDCO’s Annual First Pitch
item.description: Three area high schools will be represented at the seventh annual First Pitch by FEDCO event, where six entrepreneurial entrants will compete for cash prizes sponsored by Fulton County REMC.

item.title: FAA Pauses Indianapolis Downtown Heliport Closure After Rokita Objects
item.description: The city's purchase of the downtown Indianapolis heliport, which sits on land eyed as a potential site for a future soccer stadium, has stalled after Attorney General Todd Rokita and a Fort Wayne billionaire asked federal officials to reconsider their approval of the deal.

item.title: After Missing 48 Hours, Lafayette Man’s Parrot Lands On Wabash Welder’s Arm More Than 2 Miles Away
item.description: Buddy the Senegal parrot will spend his day perched on Blake Lefke's shoulder, keeping the 59-year-old company as the bird lets out small chirps and kisses Lefke's cheek.
